_length_probes: Fixed magnitudes that BRACKET max_sql_length, and are deliberately not computed from it. Both implementations build a statement of exactly `chars` characters and assert accept/reject, and both assert max_accept <= their own MAX_SQL_LENGTH < min_reject. A bound derived from the value it bounds holds for every value of that value: raising max_sql_length here and MAX_SQL_LENGTH in ro_grammar.py together once left `RO-GRAMMAR OK 29 cases` byte-identical at exit 0 while read_only_problem accepted a 100,007-character statement. JSON has no expressions, so a number living here cannot be re-derived from the cap. 6008 is the magnitude services/api/test/ro.test.ts has hardcoded since before PR #53.
